lead: A `Core\Db` proof program cannot get a second database flow, so one file may abandon at most one walk.
body: Two `Core\Db::connect('notes')` calls on a `:memory:` block answer the *same* connection — the second finds the first's tables — so the busy `LogicError`'s advice to "open a second connection" is unreachable from a proof, and every step after an abandoned walk meets the parked stream rather than its own subject. Keep one such step, last, and pin the rest from a `.nvst` whose final statement is the one that parks the connection.
